test.query: WITH ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('dest', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(100000) ORDER BY number ) ) AS dest_groups, ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('src', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(100000) ORDER BY number ) ) AS src_groups, if(number % 100000 < {unique_pairs}, number % 100000, 0) AS pair_index SELECT timeSeriesCopyTags(dest_groups[pair_index + 1], src_groups[pair_index + 1], ['src']) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 100000 FORMAT Null

WITH {cross_shape} AS shape, ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('dest', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(shape.2 * shape.4) ORDER BY number ) ) AS dest_groups, ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('src', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(shape.3 * shape.5) ORDER BY number ) ) AS src_groups, (number * shape.6) % 100000 AS row_index, if(row_index < shape.1, row_index, 0) AS pair_index SELECT timeSeriesCopyTags( materialize(dest_groups[(pair_index % shape.2) * shape.4 + 1]), materialize(src_groups[intDiv(pair_index, shape.2) * shape.5 + 1]), ['src']) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 100000 FORMAT Null

WITH ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('dest', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(32) ORDER BY number ) ) AS dest_groups, ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('src', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(32) ORDER BY number ) ) AS src_groups SELECT timeSeriesCopyTags(dest_groups[number % 32 + 1], src_groups[32 - number % 32], ['src']) FROM numbers(4194304) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = {block_rows} FORMAT Null

WITH ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('dest', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(100000) ORDER BY number ) ) AS dest_groups, ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('src', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(100000) ORDER BY number ) ) AS src_groups, if(number % 100000 < 75000, number % 100000, 0) AS pair_index SELECT timeSeriesCopyTag(dest_groups[pair_index + 1], src_groups[pair_index + 1], 'missing') FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 100000 FORMAT Null
